decision_rationale: VCWorld is a new biological simulator, not a review, benchmark, or wrapper. The abstract and method explicitly use LLMs with natural-language prompts/descriptions inside the model, and the paper generates stepwise textual outputs and mechanistic hypotheses.
evidence_snippet: "integrates structured biological knowledge with the iterative reasoning capabilities of large language models"; "construct a structured prompt ... into a natural language query"; "generate a comprehensive textual description"; "generates interpretable, stepwise predictions"; "LLM to function as a feature generator"; "generate a comprehensive textual description"
